name: use_skill
description: 激活指定的 skill，返回其完整指令模板（渐进式披露第二级；目录式 skill 附带附属资源清单供按需读取）。先用 list_skill 发现可用技能；args 替换模板中的 {{placeholder}} 占位符。
description_en: Activate the specified skill and return its full instruction template (progressive disclosure level 2; directory-based skills include a list of companion resources for on-demand reading). Use list_skill first to discover available skills; args replace {{placeholder}} tokens in the template.

skill.description_en: Name of the skill to invoke

args.description: 替换到技能提示词占位符中的参数（如 {topic: "react hooks"} 对应 {{topic}}）。
args.description_en: Arguments substituted into the skill prompt placeholders (e.g. {topic: "react hooks"} fills {{topic}}).
